messages.content: I'll trip to NY on December for 5 days. Can you make my plan?

function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' if State for the city exists. 'City, Country' if State for the city doesn't exist.

unit.description: The unit of temperature for the weather report.

message.content:
### 5‑Day New York City Trip – December Edition *(Assumes you’re arriving early in the day on Day 1 and leaving late on Day 5. Adjust times to fit your flight schedule.)* | Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening | |-----|---------|-----------|---------| | **Day 1 – Arrival & Midtown** | • Arrive & check into hotel (suggest: **The Westin New York at Times Square** or **Hotel 31** for budget).
• Grab a quick bite at **Joe Lupo’s** (Italian deli). | • Walk to **Times Square** – soak in the lights.
• Visit the **Top of the Rock** (Rockefeller Center) for sunset views. | • Dinner at **Carmine’s** (family‑style Italian).
• Catch a Broadway show (book in advance – e.g., *Hamilton*, *The Lion King*). | | **Day 2 – Classic Manhattan** | • Breakfast at **Balthazar** (French bistro).
• Stroll through **Bryant Park** – enjoy the holiday market & ice‑skating rink. | • Visit the **New York Public Library** & **Grand Central Terminal**.
• Lunch at **Katz’s Delicatessen** (classic pastrami). | • Explore **Union Square Holiday Market** (great for gifts).
• Dinner at **The Smith** (American).
• Night walk along the **High Line** (illuminated). | | **Day 3 – Lower Manhattan & Brooklyn** | • Breakfast at **Ess-a-Bagel**.
• Take the ferry to **Statue of Liberty** & **Ellis Island** (reserve tickets early). | • Lunch at **Stone Street** (historic cobblestone).
• Walk across the **Brooklyn Bridge** to Brooklyn Heights. | • Dinner at **Juliana’s Pizza** (Brooklyn).
• Return to Manhattan – optional: **Jazz at the Village Vanguard**. | | **Day 4 – Museums & Central Park** | • Brunch at **Sarabeth’s** (Central Park South).
• Visit the **Metropolitan Museum of Art** (or the **Museum of Modern Art** if you prefer contemporary). | • Picnic in **Central Park** (grab sandwiches from **Zabar’s**).
• Explore the **Central Park Zoo** & **Belvedere Castle**. | • Dinner at **Per Se** (if you’re splurging) or **Totto Ramen** (budget).
• Evening stroll through **Times Square** again – it’s different at night. | | **Day 5 – Departure & Last‑Minute Shopping** | • Early breakfast at **Bouchon Bakery**.
• Quick visit to **Fifth Avenue** for last‑minute holiday window displays. | • Lunch at **Shake Shack** (midtown) or **Eataly** (if you want a variety).
• Pack & check out. | • Head to the airport. If time allows, stop by **Chelsea Market** for souvenirs. | --- #### Practical Tips | Topic | Recommendation | |-------|----------------| | **Transportation** | Buy a **7‑day unlimited MetroCard** ($33) – covers subways & local buses. For airport transfers, use **NYC Airporter** or a rideshare. | | **Weather** | December in NYC averages 30–40 °F (−1 to 4 °C). Pack layers, a waterproof coat, gloves, hat, and scarf. | | **Dining Reservations** | Book restaurants 2–3 weeks ahead, especially for Broadway nights. Use OpenTable or the restaurant’s website. | | **Broadway Tickets** | For same‑day seats, try TKTS booths (Times Square, South Street Seaport). | | **Museum Pass** | Consider a **New York Pass** or **CityPASS** if you plan to visit multiple paid attractions. | | **Safety** | Keep an eye on your belongings in crowded areas. Use the official NYC 311 app for city services. | Enjoy your December adventure in the Big Apple! If you’d like more details on any activity or need help with reservations, just let me know.
